Case: Department Head signs in and lands on the Department Head dashboard
Steps: Open the HIUSA address in a browser. > Type 940001 in School ID / ID Number. > Type the password you were given. > Select Sign in.
Expected: You land on the Department Head Dashboard (the address ends with /dashboard/department-head). The top bar shows your name, your college and the label Department Head. The menu is the Department Head menu.

Case: Wrong password is refused with a clear message
Steps: Open the HIUSA address. > Type 940001 in School ID / ID Number. > Type a wrong password. > Select Sign in.
Expected: You stay on the Sign in page. A message says: That school ID and password did not match. Check both and try again, or reset your password. No dashboard opens.

Case: Sidebar shows exactly the Department Head menu
Steps: Look at the left menu after sign in. > Read the top rows in order. > Find the heading College view (read only) and read what is under it. > Select Finance and read its sub items. > Look at the bottom of the menu.
Expected: The menu reads: Dashboard, Ask AI, Organization applications, Approvals, Organizations, People, College files, Records, College compliance, Clearance signing, Announcements. Under the heading College view (read only): Finance (Budgets, Ledger, Financial reports, Forecast), Calendar, Election results. At the bottom: Study objectives, Profile and Log out. Case: Phone: the menu opens from Open menu and every Department Head page can be reached
Steps: Look at the top left of the screen. > Tap Open menu. > Tap Organizations. > Tap Open menu again and tap Approvals. > Tap Open menu again and tap Close menu.
Expected: The menu slides in as a drawer. Each tap opens the right page and the drawer closes. Close menu hides the drawer. Nothing is cut off at the sides and no page scrolls sideways.

Case: Top bar shows who you are and the account menu has only your profile and Log out
Steps: Look at the top right of the screen. > Read your name in the top bar. > Select the account button (its name starts with Account menu for). > Read the name, email, college and role at the top of the panel, then the Profiles section. > Look at the buttons under it.
Expected: The top bar itself shows only your name (and your initials). The panel shows your name, your email, then your college name and Department Head. The Profiles section lists one profile, College of Computer Studies, marked College profile and Current, and says: Your college dashboard is available without an organization membership. If an organization adds you, its profile will appear here. The buttons are View profile and Log out.

Case: Logout asks first, then returns to Sign in
Steps: Select the account button in the top bar. > Select Logout. > Read the question that appears. > Confirm the logout. > Press the browser Back button.
Expected: A confirmation appears before you are signed out. After you confirm, the Sign in page shows. Back should not show private pages again; you are asked to sign in. VERIFY: the exact words on the confirmation and what Back shows.

Case: Dashboard shows the setup steps, three tiles, the election card, upcoming events and announcements
Steps: Select Dashboard in the menu. > Read the step list at the top (Setting up your college). > Read the three tiles: Awaiting your approval, Active organizations, Upcoming events. > If an election is running read the Active election card. > Scroll down to Upcoming events and Announcements.
Expected: The page loads without an error. The step list is titled Setting up your college and has the steps Office staff added, Student records loaded, Students allowed to apply, Applications reviewed and Organizations active. The three tiles are Awaiting your approval, Active organizations and Upcoming events. The Active election card shows only while an election is running. The lower boxes are Upcoming events and Announcements; a box with nothing in it shows a short plain message (No upcoming events. or No announcements yet.), not a blank gap. When the college has no organization yet the tiles are replaced by No student organizations yet with the button Allow a student to apply. There is no Oversight snapshot and no Pending Approvals by Type box.

Case: Dashboard tiles show counts and open the matching list
Steps: Open Dashboard. > Read the three tiles: Awaiting your approval, Active organizations, Upcoming events. > Select the Active organizations tile. > Look at the address and the tab that is selected. > Go back to Dashboard and select Awaiting your approval.
Expected: Each tile shows a number. Active organizations opens Organizations with the Active tab selected (the address ends with ?status=active) and the number matches the rows on that tab. Awaiting your approval opens Approvals. A returned or pending registration filed before applications moved to the allow-to-apply flow shows as a small line such as 1 returned, 1 pending review under the Active organizations number; with none of those there is no line. There are no Returned, Pending review or Archived tiles.

Case: The Awaiting your approval tile counts the items waiting for the head and opens Approvals

Expected: The tile shows the number of requests waiting for the Department Head (for example 1 after the Admin proposes an event inside the semester) and it matches the number on the Pending tab of Approvals. Selecting the tile opens Approvals. When nothing is waiting the tile shows 0. There is no yellow banner saying N item awaiting your approval.

Case: Election card and Upcoming events box, including the empty message

Case: The Announcements box on the dashboard

Expected: Announcements shows up to three published announcements (title and a short text), or No announcements yet. View all opens the Announcements feed. There is no Pending Approvals by Type box: pending requests are counted by the Awaiting your approval tile and listed in Approvals.
